counterexample.note: The start moves to startTick + 1 only when the end tick is not a multiple of the spacing. Here 50 is a multiple of 10, so the search starts below 100 and skips it. Active liquidity is L at 100 and 0 at 50, but the walk ends at L.

summary: Sets currentTick to startTick + 1 only when the start tick is a multiple of the spacing and the end tick is not. When the end tick is also a multiple of the spacing, an initialized start tick is still skipped.
